basic_info.description: Gorgeous, stately home in prime West Portal neighborhood. Impressive curb appeal features a classic, mansion-style Mediterranean facade with an integral marbleized Faux wall finish, set back from a fenced front yard. The formal entry opens to a grand living room with fireplace, a spacious formal dining room and leads back to a modern kitchen with separate, light-filled breakfast room. There is a bedroom/den on the main level with a half bath and a custom-built sauna. Beautiful vintage details, combined with modern finishes create a dramatic and elegant living space, perfect for entertaining and enjoying family time. The top level features 4 spacious bedrooms, including a fabulous primary bedroom suite. The basement level has a bonus room, set up as a home gym. There is a separate 2-car side by side garage and a cozy, low maintenance yard. Premier location, just 2 blocks from West Portal's amazing restaurants, cafes, shops, and public transit. Truly a special home.
